title: Sphynx Cat Artist
description: A hairless sphynx cat with glasses sits at a desk in an attic, drawing fashion designs of female figures in a sketchbook with a yellow pencil. In the background, three long-haired men play saxophone, drums, and acoustic guitar in a band setup against purple bat-patterned walls.
prompt: A hairless sphynx cat wearing round glasses sits on a wooden desk in a dark attic studio, drawing blue fashion sketches of women in short dresses with a yellow pencil in a spiral notebook. Behind the cat, three long-haired bearded men perform as a band: one plays saxophone, one plays drums, and one sits playing an acoustic guitar. An open guitar case and scattered papers lie on the wooden floor. The walls have purple bat silhouettes and a skylight shows dusk light. Whimsical detailed digital painting style.
